name: Wavi Zihan
bio:
Wavi Zihan (born January 4, 1997) is an Indonesian actress and model.

Wavi started her career as a model and commercial star. Her career in film began by starring in a short film at the 2022 Layar Lokal Short Film Festival organized by the Sidoarjo Filmmakers Association. In addition, she has also worked at a food company in Japan and is a professional make-up artist. Her name began to be known since starring in the series CinLock: Love, Camera, Action! on Vision+.
